The '''Imperial Forward Camp''' was a military outpost of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] established in the [[Prowler's Trail]] of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] during the [[Revanite crisis]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Forward Camp appears as an area on Yavin in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion.<ref name="SWTOR" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' {{1st}}
